document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (総合ルール)
original_japanese_quotation: 効果を使用する場合、プレイヤーはその効果の使用を宣言し、必要なコストを支払う。コストの支払いが完了した時点で、その効果は使用されたものとして扱われ、使用回数の制限がある効果はその制限を消費する。
english_translation: When using an effect, the player declares the use of that effect and pays the required cost. At the point when cost payment is complete, that effect is treated as having been used, and effects with usage limits consume that limit.
supported_engine_behavior: Usage limits consumed post-cost deduction, strictly before resolution operations commence.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT establish "Stage 4 Atomic Commit" as an official Bandai term; does not permit consuming before cost verification.

document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (総合ルール)
original_japanese_quotation: 使用した効果が他の効果によって無効にされた場合、または解決時に対象が存在しなくなった場合でも、効果を使用した事実は取り消されず、支払ったコストや消費された使用制限は戻らない。
english_translation: Even if a used effect is negated by another effect, or if no target exists at the time of resolution, the fact that the effect was used is not revoked, and paid costs or consumed usage limits are not returned.
supported_engine_behavior: Negated effects in resolution and 0-target resolutions do not rollback limit counters or refund costs.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT apply to pre-activation prohibition (Case A) where activation was illegal.

document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (総合ルール)
original_japanese_quotation: カードがフィールドから他の領域へ移動した場合、または他の領域からフィールドへ移動した場合、そのカードは以前の領域での状態を引き継がず、新たなカード（新しいオブジェクト）として扱われる。
english_translation: When a card moves from the Field to another zone, or from another zone to Field, it does not carry over previous status and is treated as a new object.
supported_engine_behavior: Ordinary OPT binds to field placement; re-entry creates new object with fresh OPT.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT establish Once per Game reset behavior (OPG is a match-long constraint).

document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (総合ルール)
original_japanese_quotation: 契約スピリットが破壊または消滅したとき、トラッシュには置かれず、ソウル状態としてフィールドに残り続ける。
english_translation: When a Contract Spirit is destroyed or depleted, it is not placed into Trash, and continues to remain on Field as Soul State.
supported_engine_behavior: Soul State never leaves Field; field placement and consumed OPT limits persist.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT allow resetting limits while on the Field in Soul State.

document_title: Battle Spirits Comprehensive Rules (総合ルール)
original_japanese_quotation: 契約煌臨元のカードはフィールドに残り続けるカードとして扱われる。
english_translation: Contract Advent source under-cards are treated as cards continuously remaining on the Field.
supported_engine_behavior: Under-cards remain on the Field; consumed OPT limits persist while under-cards.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT allow duplicate activation while stacked under advent card.

document_title: Battle Spirits Official Floor Rules (フロアルール)
original_japanese_quotation: エラッタが適用されたカードは、過去のすべての印刷版において最新の公式テキストとして扱われます。
english_translation: Cards with official errata applied are treated as bearing the latest official text across all prior printings.
supported_engine_behavior: Reprints and errata versions share identical semantic descriptors and limits.
what_the_source_does_not_establish: Does NOT treat differing card names as equivalent.
